ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the horizontal axis represents a profile from south to north along a certain meridian, and “Qinling” is marked in the middle. There are three curves to be determined on the figure: Jia, Yi, and Bing. Jia shows an obvious mountain-peak-like protrusion near Qinling, and its form is like a topographic profile; Yi as a whole decreases from south to north; Bing has relatively high values near Qinling, and after crossing Qinling it drops obviously northward. The figure also marks auxiliary curves such as July mean temperature. The left vertical axis includes accumulated temperature of ≥10°C and annual precipitation, and the right vertical axis includes temperature and altitude. Then reason: The question asks about the annual precipitation line. Jia shows a mountain-peak-like protrusion near Qinling, which most accords with the topographic profile line, so it should be excluded; Yi as a whole decreases with latitude from south to north, which more accords with the feature that accumulated temperature of ≥10°C decreases as latitude increases, so it is also excluded. The remaining Bing both reflects the north-south precipitation difference and has the features that terrain uplift near Qinling causes precipitation to be relatively more, and precipitation decreases on the north side, therefore the annual precipitation line corresponds to Bing.
